quiz.q: What does 숨을 쉬다 mean?
quiz.why: 숨을 쉬다 means to breathe; to take a breath; to respire. 미세먼지가 너무 심한 날에는 바깥에서 마스크 없이 숨을 쉬기조차 힘들어요. (On days with severe fine dust, it is hard even to breathe outside without masks.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to use one's strength"?
quiz.why: 힘을 쓰다 means to use one's strength; to exert influence or pull strings. 무거운 냉장고를 혼자 옮기느라 허리에 온 힘을 쓰는 바람에 통증이 생겼어요. (Moving the heavy fridge alone, using all strength on back caused pain.)

quiz.q: What does 땀을 흘리다 mean?
quiz.why: 땀을 흘리다 means to sweat; to work by the sweat of one's brow. 여름철 뙤약볕 아래서 밭일을 하느라 온몸이 흠뻑 젖도록 땀을 흘렸어요. (Doing field work under the summer sun, I sweated until soaked all over.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be ripped off"?
quiz.why: 바가지를 쓰다 means to be ripped off; to be overcharged. 관광지 식당에서 평소 가격보다 세 배나 비싸게 바가지를 썼어요. (At a tourist site restaurant, I was ripped off paying triple the normal price.)

quiz.q: What does 잠이 들다 mean?
quiz.why: 잠이 들다 means to fall asleep; to drop off to sleep. 하루 종일 산행을 다녀와서 너무 피곤했던지 눕자마자 바로 잠이 들었어요. (So tired after hiking all day, I fell asleep right after lying down.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to make time"?
quiz.why: 시간을 내다 means to make time; to spare some time for someone or something. 바쁘신 와중에도 소중한 시간을 내어 참석해 주셔서 진심으로 감사합니다. (Thank you very much for sparing precious time to attend amidst your busy schedule.)

quiz.q: What does 시간이 들다 mean?
quiz.why: 시간이 들다 means to cost time; to take time and labor. 전통 발효 음식을 제대로 만들려면 많은 정성과 시간이 들어요. (To properly make traditional fermented food, it takes much care and time.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "time flows"?
quiz.why: 시간이 흐르다 means time flows; time passes like water. 아무리 깊은 슬픔과 상처라도 시간이 흐르면 차츰 아물기 마련이에요. (No matter how deep sadness is, it heals gradually as time flows.)

quiz.q: What does 관심을 가지다 mean?
quiz.why: 관심을 가지다 means to take an interest in; to pay attention to. 어릴 때부터 환경 문제에 깊은 관심을 가지고 재활용 분리수거를 실천했어요. (From childhood, I took deep interest in environmental issues and practiced recycling.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to make up one's mind"?
quiz.why: 마음을 먹다 means to make up one's mind; to set one's heart on doing something. 새해를 맞이하여 이번에는 반드시 금연에 성공하겠다고 굳게 마음을 먹었어요. (Entering the new year, I firmly made up my mind to succeed in quitting smoking.)

quiz.q: What does 최선을 다하다 mean?
quiz.why: 최선을 다하다 means to do one's best; to do one's utmost; to spare no effort. 결과가 어떻게 나오든 후회가 남지 않도록 매 순간 최선을 다했어요. (Whatever the result turns out, I gave my all every moment to leave no regret.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to dream a dream"?
quiz.why: 꿈을 꾸다 means to dream a dream; to cherish an ambition or aspiration. 어젯밤에 하늘을 훨훨 날아다니는 신기하고 아름다운 꿈을 꾸었어요. (Last night I dreamed a marvelous and beautiful dream flying in the sky.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to wet one's whistle"?
quiz.why: 목을 축이다 means to wet one's whistle; to quench one's thirst slightly. 가파른 산행을 하다가 시원한 샘물 한 모금으로 타는 듯한 목을 축였어요. (Hiking steep mountains, I quenched my burning thirst with cold spring water.)

quiz.q: What does 입이 가볍다 mean?
opts: to be right under one's nose
quiz.why: 입이 가볍다 means to be loose-lipped; unable to keep a secret. 그 사람은 입이 가벼워서 중요한 이야기를 절대로 털어놓으면 안 돼요. (That person is so loose-lipped that you must never tell him important matters.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to look familiar"?
quiz.why: 낯이 익다 means to look familiar; to be recognizable. 지하철에서 마주친 사람이 어디서 많이 본 듯 낯이 익어요. (The person I encountered on the subway looked familiar, as if seen somewhere.)

quiz.q: What does 약속을 어기다 mean?
quiz.why: 약속을 어기다 means to break a promise; to go back on one's word. 친구가 아무런 연락도 없이 약속을 어겨서 약속 장소에서 1시간이나 기다렸어요. (My friend broke the appointment with no contact, so I waited an hour.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to fail an exam or audition"?
quiz.why: 미역국을 먹다 means to fail an exam or audition; to get rejected. 열심히 준비한 공무원 시험에서 또 미역국을 먹어서 속상해요. (Failing the civil service exam I prepared hard for makes me very upset.)

quiz.q: What does 연락이 닿다 mean?
quiz.why: 연락이 닿다 means to get in touch with; to reach someone by phone or message. 수소문 끝에 20년 동안 소식이 끊겼던 초등학교 동창과 마침내 연락이 닿았어요. (After searching, I finally got in touch with an elementary classmate after 20 years.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to give up one's seat"?
quiz.why: 자리를 양보하다 means to give up one's seat; to yield one's place to someone. 만원 버스에서 무거운 짐을 들고 계신 어르신을 보고 얼른 자리를 양보해 드렸어요. (Seeing a senior with heavy bags on a crowded bus, I quickly gave up my seat.)

quiz.q: What does 자리를 비우다 mean?
opts: to be away from one's desk
quiz.why: 자리를 비우다 means to be away from one's desk; to leave one's seat. 잠깐 화장실에 가느라 자리를 비운 사이에 중요한 거래처에서 전화가 왔었네요. (While away from my desk briefly for the restroom, an important client called.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to yield results"?
quiz.why: 결과를 낳다 means to yield results; to bring about outcomes; to result in. 꾸준한 연구 개발 투자가 마침내 세계 최초의 원천 기술 개발이라는 결과를 낳았다. (Persistent R&D investment finally yielded results of pioneering world-first tech.)

quiz.q: What does 영향을 미치다 mean?
quiz.why: 영향을 미치다 means to exert influence on; to have an effect on. 어릴 적 독서 습관은 평생의 사고력과 가치관 형성에 지대한 영향을 미쳐요. (Childhood reading habits exert profound influence on lifelong thinking and values.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to take the first step"?
quiz.why: 첫 단추를 끼우다 means to take the first step; to start off on the right foot. 대학 생활의 첫 단추를 잘 끼워야 졸업 때까지 보람차게 보낼 수 있어요. (Buttoning the first button of college life well brings fruitful years until graduation.)

quiz.why: 시간을 끌다 means to stall for time; to buy time; to drag one's feet. 답변을 회피하며 억지로 시간을 끌어 보았자 문제만 더 커질 뿐이에요. (Stalling for time by evading answers will only make the problem bigger.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to devote effort to"?
quiz.why: 노력을 기울이다 means to devote effort to; to exert oneself toward a goal. 한국어 발음을 정확하게 교정하기 위해 거울을 보며 매일 노력을 기울였어요. (To correct Korean pronunciation accurately, I devoted effort every day in the mirror.)

quiz.q: What does 눈총을 받다 mean?
quiz.why: 눈총을 받다 means to draw glares; to face stern glares or public censure. 도서관에서 시끄럽게 통화하다가 주변 사람들로부터 따가운 눈총을 받았어요. (Talking loudly on the phone in the library, I drew sharp glares from people.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to pull oneself together"?
quiz.why: 마음을 잡다 means to pull oneself together; to steady one's mind and refocus. 방황하던 사춘기 시절을 끝내고 다시 마음을 잡고 학업에 열중했어요. (Ending teenage wandering, I pulled myself together and focused on studies.)

quiz.q: What does 색안경을 끼고 보다 mean?
quiz.why: 색안경을 끼고 보다 means to view with prejudice; to look at someone through colored glasses. 외모나 출신 배경만 보고 색안경을 끼고 사람을 대하면 안 돼요. (You must not treat people through tinted glasses based on looks or background.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be passionate about"?
quiz.why: 열을 올리다 means to be passionate about; to get heated up over something. 토론 대회 참가자들은 자기주장을 관철하기 위해 얼굴이 붉어지도록 열을 올렸다. (Debate participants heated up with red faces to push their own arguments.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be on the edge of one's seat"?
quiz.why: 손에 땀을 쥐다 means to be on the edge of one's seat; breathless suspense. 월드컵 축구 경기 결승전은 손에 땀을 쥐게 할 만큼 박진감이 넘쳤어요. (The World Cup final match was so thrilling that it kept everyone on the edge of their seats.)

quiz.q: What does 찬물을 끼얹다 mean?
quiz.why: 찬물을 끼얹다 means to throw cold water on; to dampen the mood or progress. 축제 분위기로 들떠 있는 자리에 부서장이 찬물을 끼얹는 쓴소리를 했어요. (In a festive mood, the department head poured cold water with bitter remarks.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to sweat bullets"?
quiz.why: 진땀을 흘리다 means to sweat bullets; to have a grueling, tough time dealing with something. 면접관의 날카로운 압박 질문에 대답하느라 진땀을 흘렸어요. (Answering the interviewer's sharp grilling questions made me sweat bullets.)

quiz.q: What does 가슴에 못을 박다 mean?
quiz.why: 가슴에 못을 박다 means to break someone's heart; to deeply wound someone's feelings. 부모님 가슴에 못을 박는 심한 말을 하고 나서 며칠 동안 후회했어요. (I regretted for days after uttering harsh words driving nails into my parents' hearts.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be moved to tears"?
quiz.why: 눈시울이 붉어지다 means to be moved to tears; eyes welling up with tears. 어머니의 낡은 손을 꼭 잡는 순간 나도 모르게 눈시울이 붉어졌어요. (Holding my mother's worn hands tightly, tears welled up in my eyes unknowingly.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to whet one's appetite"?
quiz.why: 입맛을 돋우다 means to whet one's appetite; to stimulate the palate. 새콤달콤한 봄나물 무침이 지쳐 있던 입맛을 산뜻하게 돋우어 주네요. (Sweet and sour spring greens refreshingly whet my tired appetite.)

quiz.q: What does 귀가 얇다 mean?
quiz.why: 귀가 얇다 means to be gullible; to be easily influenced by others' words. 귀가 얇아서 남들이 좋다고 추천하는 물건은 바로 사 버려요. (Because I am gullible, I immediately buy anything others recommend as good.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to stand by with folded arms"?
quiz.why: 뒷짐을 지다 means to stand by with folded arms; to remain an idle onlooker. 모두가 밤새워 일하는데 혼자 뒷짐을 지고 구경만 하면 어떡해요? (How can you just stand by with folded arms watching while everyone works overnight?)

quiz.q: What does 성의를 다하다 mean?

quiz.why: 성의를 다하다 means to do something in all sincerity; to devote one's full sincerity. 손님 한 분 한 분을 모실 때마다 성의를 다해 친절하게 응대하고 있어요. (Whenever serving every single guest, we respond kindly with all sincerity.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be generous"?

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to cut ties with"?
quiz.why: 담을 쌓다 means to cut ties with; to build a wall against; to have nothing to do with. 운동과 담을 쌓고 살았더니 계단 몇 개만 올라도 숨이 차요. (Living with a wall built against exercise, even a few stairs make me breathless.)

quiz.q: What does 등을 떠밀다 mean?
opts: to push someone into doing something
quiz.why: 등을 떠밀다 means to push someone into doing something; to nudge or pressure. 친구들이 등을 떠미는 바람에 얼떨결에 장기자랑 무대에 올라갔어요. (With friends pushing my back, I ended up on the talent show stage in a daze.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to have a wide circle of acquaintances"?
quiz.why: 발이 넓다 means to have a wide circle of acquaintances; to be well-connected. 그 친구는 발이 넓어서 어느 모임에 가나 아는 사람이 있어요. (That friend is so well-connected that he knows someone in every gathering.)

quiz.q: What does 파리를 날리다 mean?
opts: to do something in all sincerity
quiz.why: 파리를 날리다 means to have no customers; business is dead; to sit around shooing flies. 경기 침체로 상가 골목의 많은 식당들이 손님이 없어 파리를 날리고 있어요. (Due to recession, many restaurants in commercial alleys sit shooing flies.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be caught red-handed"?
quiz.why: 뒷덜미를 잡히다 means to be caught red-handed; to have one's dirty secret or vulnerability seized. 치밀하게 준비했던 횡령 수법이 내부 감사 과정에서 뒷덜미를 잡혔어요. (The embezzlement method prepared meticulously was caught in internal audit.)

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to nail down"?

quiz.q: What does 입에 발린 말 mean?

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to remain silent"?

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to be struck with awe"?

quiz.q: What does 발자취를 남기다 mean?

quiz.q: Which idiom means "to open the floodgates"?

quiz.q: What does 호가호위 mean?
opts: borrowing someone else's authority to bully others
working by day and studying by night
quiz.why: 호가호위 means borrowing someone else's authority to bully others; swaggering in borrowed plumes. 부장의 친척이라고 호가호위하며 거들먹거리면 다들 싫어해요. (Everyone dislikes it when someone swaggers around borrowing the manager's power as his relative.)

quiz.q: Which four-character idiom means "ingratitude"?
quiz.why: 배은망덕 means ingratitude; biting the hand that feeds you. 키워 준 부모님의 뜻을 무시하고 떠나다니 배은망덕한 짓이에요. (Disregarding the will of the parents who raised you is an act of biting the hand that fed you.)

quiz.q: What does 아전인수 mean?
opts: a third party reaping the profit while two others quarrel
quiz.why: 아전인수 means seeking one's own advantage; self-serving interpretation. 규정을 자기한테 유리하게만 해석하는 건 아전인수격 주장이에요. (Interpreting rules only to one's own benefit is a self-serving argument.)

quiz.q: Which four-character idiom means "bluffing"?
quiz.why: 허장성세 means bluffing; putting on a brave front with empty bluster. 겉으로는 부자 행세를 하지만 실상은 빚더미에 오른 허장성세였어요. (Pretending to be rich on the outside was mere empty bluffing, while in truth drowned in debt.)

quiz.q: What does 교언영색 mean?
quiz.why: 교언영색 means sweet talk and flattering manners; glib speech and an oily smile. 교언영색으로 남을 속이려는 사람의 말은 믿지 않는 게 좋아요. (It is better not to trust words from someone trying to deceive others with flattering manners.)

quiz.q: Which four-character idiom means "deceiving others with shallow tricks"?
quiz.why: 조삼모사 means deceiving others with shallow tricks; playing fast and loose. 가격을 올려놓고 할인해 주는 척하는 건 조삼모사나 다름없어요. (Raising prices and pretending to discount them is no different from shallow deception.)
